The patient is a 43-year-old woman with unexplained severe chest pain and echocardiographic evidence of **left ventricular enlargement (LVE)** and **left atrial enlargement (LAE)** — i.e., *biventricular* is inaccurate in the impression (TTE only confirms left-sided chamber enlargement; right ventricular or right atrial size is not mentioned). gaps.info: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) and global longitudinal strain (GLS) from echocardiography

gaps.info: Echocardiographic assessment of mitral valve structure and regurgitation severity
gaps.discriminates: DCM (primary myocardial disease) vs. secondary DCM due to severe valvular regurgitation (e.g., flail mitral leaflet, myxomatous degeneration)

gaps.info: Family history of cardiomyopathy, sudden cardiac death, or heart failure
gaps.discriminates: Genetic/familial dilated cardiomyopathy vs. acquired or sporadic forms; also informs risk stratification and cascade testing
